decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates shall be carried out in accordance with the materials specified on the approved plans and on the submitted application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The flat roof area(s) of the development to which this permission relates shall not be used as a roof garden, balcony, seating area or other similar amenity area, and shall not be accessed except for the purpose of maintenance or in the case of emergency.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of the original planning permission ref: 25/00097/HOUF dated 12.03.2025. Reason: This is required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Prior to beneficial occupation of the development to which this permission relates, any windows at the first floor level on the north and south (side) elevations shall be constructed so that no part of the framework less than 1.7m above finished floor level shall be openable. Any part below that level shall be fitted with and permanently retained in obscure glazing to a minimum of level 3 on the standard scale. Any film used to achieve the requisite obscurity level shall be non-perishable, tamper-proof, and shall be replaced immediately in the event that it ceases to result in obscurity to level 3.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 ofthe London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the Fire Safety Statement hereby approved.Reason: In the interests of Fire Safety and to ensure the safety of all building users in accordance with Policy D12 (Fire safety) of the London Plan 2021.

The development to which this permission relates shall be carried out in accordance with Tree Protection Plan December 2023 and BS5837:2012 Tree Survey And Arboricultural Impact Assessment. The approved measures shall be implemented prior to commencement of any work on site and maintained to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority until the completion of the development.Reason: To safeguard trees worthy of retention and in the interests of the character and appearance of the area, in accordance with policy G7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

A minimum of 3 swift bricks must be incorporated within the external walls of the development hereby approved, prior to occupation, and must be retained thereafter.Reason: To enhance the biodiversity of the site in accordance with the Kingston Swift (Flagship) Species Action Plan (2023), Policy DM6 of the Kingston Core Strategy (2012) and Policy G6 of the London Plan (2021).

Prior to beneficial occupation of the development to which this permission relates, privacy screening 1.8m in height as measured from the floor level adjacent to the screen, shall be erected along the southern side of the outdoor terrace as shown on drawing no. C01C. Aside from essential fixings, the screen(s) shall be constructed entirely of obscure glazing to a minimum of level 3 on the standard scale. Any film used to achieve the requisite obscurity level shall be non-perishable, tamper-proof, and shall be replaced immediately in the event that it ceases to result in obscurity to level 3. The screening hereby approved shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.
